content: Vercel Functions limits (vercel.com/docs/functions/limitations, updated 2026-08-24): max payload size for request OR response body is 4.5MB; exceeding returns 413 FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; streaming is the documented bypass. Constrains base64-in-JSON ingest-response asset transport on the minimal prod deploy (Vite dev middleware + CI unaffected).
